Name: (RSV) A Different Lenny - New Portrait Mod
Author: misslune
Description:
This is a new portrait I have created for the character Lenny from the much beloved Ridgeside Village by Rafseazz. It will replace both her normal portrait and her beach portrait, and should still correspond well with the original walking sprites. 


Installation:  Unzip and drop that bad boy into your mods folder.  Goes without saying that this mod won't do anything without Ridgeside, Content Patcher, or SMAPI.
